activeTitanRule: Trials showcase exactly one temporary Titan at a time; borrowed loadouts never become permanent combat power.
purpose: Production Titan Trial and Faction Trial model for onboarding handoff, roster discovery, temporary specialist loadouts, Divine Ascension previews, and conversion-safe rewards.

trialModes.label: Temporary Loadout
trialModes.rule: Borrowed relics vanish after the showcase; only Trial Favor persists.

trialModes.label: Faction Trial
trialModes.rule: Aten Ra tactical pressure teaches roster difference without requiring ownership.

trialModes.label: Divine Ascension Preview
trialModes.rule: Signature burst is demonstrated at capped power; no ranked or shop currency rewards.

temporaryLoadoutRules: Each trial attempt creates a tempLoadout with relic, gearScore, and expires=END_OF_TRIAL.
Temporary gear cannot be claimed, sold, fused, ranked, or used in raid economy.
Trial completion may grant Trial Favor, starter shards, XP, and at most first-showcase relic discovery credit.
Repeated showcases decay rewards and preserve only best score history.
factionTrialRules: Every completion writes factionTrials.bestScores by factionId.
Faction trial history records factionId, titanId, score, quality, and timestamp.
Trials teach faction combat philosophy without locking missions behind ownership.
Conversion path is recommendation and favor economy only, never mandatory purchase pressure.

STUDIED.read: Safest learning route; best for preserving Favor efficiency.

BALANCED.read: Default showcase route; balanced score and risk.

AGGRESSIVE.read: Fast clear; lower learning bonus and higher damage.

rewardGuardrails: Trial Favor persists; borrowed gear does not.
No shop currency, PvP rating, raid tokens, or uncapped materials from trials.
First-showcase rewards are stronger than repeats to avoid farming loops.
Best scores inform recommendations, not hard locks.
acceptanceCriteria: Command Hub exposes a Trials tab with trial options from canonical Titans.
A trial attempt creates ACTIVE state, tempLoadout, mode label, lessons, and save-backed attempt history.
Resolving a trial creates titanTrials completion, factionTrials completion, pending TITAN_TRIAL cache, and Trial Favor resource.
Borrowed tempLoadout expires at END_OF_TRIAL and no permanent gear item is granted.
TG-DEV-027 is marked COMPLETED only when validation and browser smoke cover the loop.
sourceCultureTemporaryLoadoutRule: Temporary trial relics, gearScore, and lessons must use the Titan source-culture weapon/armor/core names; borrowed gear never appears as generic relic, realmplate, or charge core.
